assertion.statement: Unit-vector nilcharacters admit tensor/conjugate symbol arithmetic; top-invariant comparison functions descend and give the specified lower-support equivalence.
assertion.objects: Rational filtered G/Gamma, global polynomial orbit g, unit vector F, real vertical character eta integral on Gamma intersect G_d; tensor targets may differ.
assertion.hypotheses: Finite downset, connected simply connected nilpotent G, rational filtration; after U02 the top is central; each comparison has identical integer-valued domain.
assertion.quantifiers: Every such representation and every finite tensor/conjugation used in (3),(11)-(16).
assertion.parameter_range: Degree D>0 or multidegree d nonzero; standard finite dimensions and tensor exponents.
assertion.uniformity: Tensor, contraction and restriction bounds depend on fixed powers and geometry, never on orbit coefficients.
assertion.constants: No approximation error; tensor norm of a unit vector is exactly one.
assertion.normalizations: Addition of symbols means tensor product, negation conjugation, equality tested by chi tensor conjugate of chi-prime. Signed tensor exponent 0 is scalar 1.
assertion.exceptional_cases: Negative exponents use conjugation; degree zero is treated separately in Theorem 5.
assertion.limit_order: Fix geometric and tensor data before limit coefficients; identities hold under natural ultrapowers.

use.reason: The actual LP05 convention imports E7/E8(i)–(iii); LP13 supplies different rational geometry. The source card is explicitly a project paraphrase of the pinned final publication.

supplier.statement: Nilcharacter equivalence is an equivalence relation; bounded componentwise linear representation by another nilcharacter tensored with a lower-degree nilsequence characterizes this equivalence, and tensor product induces an abelian symbol group.

publication.title: An inverse theorem for the Gowers U^{s+1}[N]-norm

publication.corrections: Only the equivalence/group-law clauses are used here on the separately tautified strong represented class. Other AppendixE clauses and local corrections retain separate proofs and contracts.
